say:1:1460708001:1.text: Magister, thanks to your efforts and those of your companions, the revival of the Homestead is well on its way!
say:1:1460708001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，看来家园的复兴已经在您和同伴们的努力下逐步踏...
say:1:1460708001:1.male: Magister, thanks to your efforts and those of your companions, the revival of the Homestead is well on its way!
say:1:1460708001:1.female: Magister, thanks to your efforts and those of your companions, the revival of the Homestead is well on its way!

say:2:1460708002:1.text: Taking care of your companions' needs is just as important as the rebuilding process. Let's check in with them and see if they need anything.
say:2:1460708002:1.source_cn: 保障好同伴们的后勤，也是我们重要的工作之一呢，让我们听...

say:4:1460708003:1.text: I'm feeling a bit hungry... I wish someone could sell me a round loaf of bread.
say:4:1460708003:1.source_cn: 有点饿啊……要是有人能卖给我一个圆面包就好了。

say:5:1460708004:1.text: Head over to the kitchen and bake a round bread! Don't forget—while we're at it, we'll need to charge a fair price.
say:5:1460708004:1.source_cn: 我们快去厨房做出圆面包吧！当然，可不能让您免费提供，我...
say:5:1460708004:1.male: Head over to the kitchen and bake a round bread! Don't forget—while we're at it, we'll need to charge a fair price.
say:5:1460708004:1.female: Head over to the kitchen and bake a round bread! Don't forget—while we're at it, we'll need to charge a fair price.

say:6:1460708005:1.text: Congratulations! Looks like this is our first official order.
say:6:1460708005:1.source_cn: 如果用生意人的话来说，这大概就是我们接到的第一笔订单吧。
